turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of a class?
That's not an answer, Hale. I'm waiting.
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Don't flatter me, Hale. Owen's reading level isn't why he has a zero. What do you actually have?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Then why did nobody call that parent before the zero went in? Your own procedure 4.2 says you contact me first. Show me what you have, or I'm going upstairs.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
You'd love my blessing. You entered a zero without calling me, Hale, so no, you don't get my trust on credit. Withdraw it, or put whatever you have on this desk.
